sha.description: The commit, in hex: one of `commits`.

count.description: How many lines it runs for.

start.description: The run's first line, counted from 1.

hunk.description: A run of lines one commit last changed.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such repository, revision or file.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The file is binary, or too large to blame.

ref.description: The ref or commit shown, as `ref` named it, less any path.

hunks.description: Its lines in runs, each last changed by one commit, from the first line on.

lines.description: How many lines the text has.

ranges.description: The ranges its highlighting paints, encoded as the pages read them, as dev.knotless.getFile has them.

commits.description: Each commit a run names, once.

ref.description: A branch, a tag or a commit, which may run on into the path, as dev.knotless.getFile takes it; the default branch if absent.

path.description: A file in the tree, from its root.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getFile takes it.

main.description: Who last changed each line of a text file at a revision, as git blame finds it: the file's text, the ranges its highlighting paints, its lines in runs from the same commit, and each of those commits once. A binary file, or one over 256 KiB, is refused. No authentication needed; asked as an account, with a service token or the pages' session cookie, a private repository it is a member of is read too, and the answer is that account's alone.

path.description: The file's path in that parent, from the root.

previous.description: Where blame goes on before the run's commit: its parent, and the file's path there. Absent where the commit made the file.

description: Who last changed each line of a file at a revision.
